note: Union of the confirmed findings of the old lens run, the new lens run and the single-agent Opus review, each checked against change.patch. Recorded by location and category only: change.patch has every Hebrew word and every name-bearing identifier replaced with a placeholder, so nothing here says who anyone is. `alternates` are other spots (or categories) where the same issue is equally well cited.

issues.summary: The spec's header comment and fixture constants carry what look like real team members, with a relation and a fixed rota; the repo's rule is placeholders only.
The runbook describes the real roster (which of the team's children lack an area, who is missing from the sheet) instead of generic steps.
This migration's timestamp sorts after the sibling milestone's planned, unmerged migration (needs: none), so whichever ships second is refused by `supabase db push`.
The drive's family is looked up by child name with a non-STRICT select into, so two children with one name silently get an arbitrary one.
The seed's 'no practice on weekday' refusal has no failure-path test; the other refusals each have one.
The header promises a re-run replaces a loaded drive, but a drop leaves the old row and a family moving between the cars of one leg hits the unique (slot, direction, parent) key and aborts.
The re-run test is titled 'no second drive' but only compares parent and child ids; standing_drives is never checked.
The area-refusal test fails on the first family, before any insert, so its 'adds no one' assertion cannot fail.
'adds every family' asserts only more than one family, so a dropped placeholder row still passes.
The cross-family update check reads only `.data ?? []`, so a request that errors for an unrelated reason passes as 'denied'.
The outsider read check reads only `.data ?? []`, so an erroring read passes as 'no rows visible'.
childButton and enterAs are redefined in three new specs, and the existing invite-link-access spec already has the pick-child helpers.
second-parent writes the join_group RPC call and its row check inline, repeating names-and-seats' addFamily helper.
